name: Elle Byrne
source:
Sherri, Kealey, and Nina's former Magical Girl ally. Always the baby of the group, she was the whole team's little sister and loved dearly by her three closest friends. Sadly, she passed away in 2007, long before her time. Elle Byrne was fifteen years old when she died, and the shock of that death changed her three friends forever. But how did she die? What happened that fateful night? And why couldn't Sherri, Kealey, and Nina stop it?

[From in-game bio]
